# Jithin Raaj

> Head of Social Media at Entri and automation builder. I write about operational problems I solve at work — internal tools, reporting systems, and automation built without engineering teams.

## About

Jithin Raaj is Head of Social Media at Entri, based in Kochi, India. He has built the social media operation from scratch across five languages — YouTube, Instagram, Facebook. He builds internal tools and automation systems to solve operational problems in social media and lead generation. He writes about the process — what the problem was, how he thought about it, and what he built. All tools are built using Claude Code and Cursor without dedicated engineering teams.

## Featured Posts

- /writing/what-is-vibe-coding/ — Personal story of vibe coding: from 2022 manual Google Sheets work to production tools with Claude Code. What it means for someone who runs operations, not engineering.
- /writing/automate-daily-lead-performance-report/ — How to automate a daily OKR lead performance report without a data team. Built with Claude Code, delivers ranked urgency email every morning.
- /writing/monitor-instagram-stories-multiple-accounts/ — How to monitor 25+ Instagram pages for story activity and spacing violations. Built StoryDash to replace 30 minutes of manual daily checking.
- /writing/build-chrome-extension-without-coding/ — How to build Chrome extensions to extract data from dashboards with no export or API. No JavaScript knowledge required.

## Projects

- /projects/storydash/ — StoryDash: real-time Instagram story monitoring dashboard. Monitors 25+ pages, detects spacing violations, sends automated hourly email reports to the team.
- /projects/okr-report-system/ — OKR Lead Report System: automated daily email tracking lead performance across all categories with month-end projections and urgency ranking.

## Key Topics

- Vibe coding for non-developers and operations teams
- Automation built without engineering teams
- Internal reporting tools (OKR tracking, lead performance)
- Social media operations at scale (Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, five languages)
